data.cultural_impact: The name Valand has a rich cultural significance in the Hindu tradition. It is a name that conveys the ideals of protection and strength, which holds great importance in Hindu society. It is believed that the god Vishnu, who is responsible for preserving Dharma (cosmic order) and protecting the universe, is invoked whenever the name Valand is used. This connection to Vishnu adds to the reverence and respect attached to the name.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Valand represents the innate desire to protect and care for those around us. It is a reminder of our responsibility towards the welfare of others and our duty to uphold righteousness and truth. The name serves as a constant reminder of the power and strength within us to defend and protect those we love, and to always remain steadfast in our convictions, just like the god Vishnu who is known as the preserver of the universe.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Valand is a name of wisdom and knowledge. It represents the inner seeker, always thirsty for truth and understanding. The syllable 'Val' signifies wisdom, while 'And' symbolizes the eternal quest for knowledge.

Valandar refers to the presiding deity of the Sangam, Lord Vishnu in his Valandidevan form. The event saw the collection, compilation and preservation of ancient Tamil literary works.

Valandar is also revered as a god of divination and is invoked during important rituals and ceremonies.
